No prior alerts for this user suggest the account may have been compromised and is being abused for lateral movement or privilege escalation.

5. **MITRE Mapping**: Perfect score match to T1003.001 (LSASS Memory) under Credential Access. MITRE tool mapping also confirms ProcDump is explicitly listed as a known tool for this technique.

6. **Prior DC-01 Alert**: A prior alert on DC-01 ~1 hour before this event (21:11 vs 22:11) suggests this may be part of a broader, ongoing intrusion campaign.

7. **No Benign Justification**: No authorized change window, no known red team activity, no legitimate reason for a backup service account to dump LSASS on a DC.

**Immediate containment is required**: isolate DC-01, disable/reset svc-backup, rotate all domain credentials (krbtgt x2, all privileged accounts), and initiate IR procedures for potential domain compromise.
